name: Compact MVP Restaurant
_comment: PRD §14 'Restaurant layout'. Compact and highly readable: the owner's travel path must matter, but the space must stay small enough that movement is not a tedious commute. Coordinates are world units on the XZ plane; +Z runs from the street (entry) to the back of house.

staff._comment: PRD §7 'Staffing setup' — the initial worker roster and the posts setup_submit's `staffAssignments` may name. §7's first playable version is '1 cook, 1 server, 1 owner-player', so the roster is two hired workers; the owner is the player and is never assigned a post. `posts` is the closed vocabulary of assignable positions: the four kitchen stations (each pointing at the station entity above) plus the three front-of-house posts. `dining_room` is spelled exactly as PRD §12's `setup_submit` example spells it, which is why the post id and the zone id differ. Worker roles come from WORKER_ROLES in shared/schemas/game-state.js; `prep_worker` and `host` are declared there but not rostered for MVP, per §7 ('Optional for MVP; may be abstracted initially').

roster.name: Cook
roster.description: Prepares dishes at kitchen stations. Can create a prep backlog.

roster.name: Server
roster.description: Seats, takes orders, delivers food, clears tables. Can be overwhelmed by a large dining room.
